name: Logo Bar / Trust Bar
summary: Passive logo or trust-mark collection with static and source-backed marquee presentation.

anatomy.name: logos
anatomy.description: Ordered target-owned logo or trust-mark composition.

states.name: logoHover
states.description: Pointer-only visual emphasis for a passive raster mark. Vector marks use the same treatment without creating activation semantics.

states.name: linkedLogoFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus when a target wraps a mark in a native link.

behavior.name: passiveMarks
behavior.description: Marks are passive by default. A target may wrap a mark in a native link only when a real destination exists and must then provide link semantics and focus treatment.

behavior.name: marqueeBoundary
behavior.description: The class is source-backed presentation evidence only; content duplication, travel distance, timing, pause controls, and announcements remain unresolved and target-owned. Reduced motion renders a wrapped static collection.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional visible label for the mark collection.

properties.name: logos
properties.description: Ordered target-owned logo or trust-mark content.

accessibility: Each informative mark has an appropriate accessible name; decorative duplicate marks are hidden from assistive technology.
Passive marks do not receive link semantics. Linked marks use native anchors with visible focus and descriptive destination names.
Marquee presentation pauses for focus and hover, and reduced motion renders a static wrapping collection without duplicate announcements.
